other_conditions: Must have at least 3 years of post‑doctoral experience.
Must have continuous working experience in a R&D or academic institution in Kerala for the last 3 years.
Must be nominated by a Vice‑Chancellor, Director of an R&D centre, Head of an institution/department, or Fellow of a listed academy.
Age must not exceed 37 years as of 31 December of the notifying year.
Nomination is valid for 3 years or until the age limit, whichever is earlier.
benefits_summary: Awardees receive a certificate, a cash prize of ₹50,000, and may be considered for a research grant of up to ₹50 lakh and an overseas conference visit within three years.
